paragraphs: Kiddushin 40b relates that R' Tarfon and the elders were reclining in the upper room of Nitzah’s house in Lod.[^1][^2]

notes.text: מ: gives Kiddushin 40b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification.

Nitzah is the retained conventional transliteration of supplied נתזה, without independently fixing vowels or identity from a familiar Talmudic form. Upper room, house, reclining and Lod all remain. The elders is a common designation rather than an added formal body; Tarfon’s abbreviated title remains R'.
